To whom it may concern, I am writing to provide my statement regarding the incident that occurred on 12/15/2025. On Monday, December 15, 2025, at approximately 6:51 a.m., I was driving my 2023 Chevrolet Equinox LT northbound on County Route 18 near Mill Lane, Maple Crossing, NY 12009. It was still dark and the roads were clear. As I approached the area near Mill Lane, a deer suddenly entered the roadway from the right shoulder and ran into the path of my vehicle. I had no time to react or stop. The deer made contact with the front of my vehicle, striking the front grille area and right front corner. After the impact, I pulled over to the right as much as possible and turned on my hazard lights. I inspected the damage and saw that the front bumper, grille, hood edge, and right headlamp were damaged. The right headlamp was not working, and parts of the front fascia were loose. Because of the damage and the headlamp being out, I did not feel it was safe to continue driving. I contacted roadside assistance and had the vehicle towed to a repair facility later that morning. There were no injuries to myself or any passengers. No other vehicles were involved. This statement is true and accurate to the best of my knowledge.
